1 import fs from 'node:fs';

3 // Shared swarm look-in — NOT a kill timer.
4 //
5 // John's rule (2026-08-27, restating the 2026-08-24 Foreman checkpoint-supervision
6 // design / Move 6): the orchestrator LOOKS IN on a long-running seat — trail +
7 // 3-line self-report vs the locked North Star, Rabbit-Catcher RC-6 + elegance —
8 // and lets a TALKING agent tidy itself. Time-since-start is not a kill reason
9 // when the seat is heartbeating. Silence is: spawned seats MUST respond; look
10 // in, then kill and respawn once. Self-report is never trusted without a trail.
11 //
12 // Consumed by researchPrime panel, Crucible Sharks, Foreman seats, Gandalf
13 // refuters, Jumper spheres. One module, no per-skill fork.
14 
15 /** First "are you there?" — spawned seats MUST heartbeat. Silence is not work. */
16 export const DEFAULT_CHECKIN_MS = 90 * 1000;
17 /** After a look-in demand, still silent → kill and respawn. */
18 export const DEFAULT_SILENT_KILL_MS = 60 * 1000;
19 /** Idle since LAST heartbeat went quiet (a talking seat that died). */
20 export const DEFAULT_DEAD_IDLE_MS = 90 * 1000;
21 /** One restart. A seat that dies twice is not something we keep feeding. */
22 export const DEFAULT_MAX_RESPAWN = 1;
23 
24 /**
25  * Prompt fragment every swarm seat carries. The agent writes a heartbeat the
26  * orchestrator can read; if it notices a rabbit hole it cuts itself.
27  * @param {{ heartbeatPath?: string, northStar?: string }} [o]
28  */
29 export function lookinAppendix({ heartbeatPath, northStar } = {}) {
30   const hb = heartbeatPath || 'heartbeat.json';
31   return [
32     `LOOK-IN: you MUST write ${hb} as JSON {doing, why, next, load_bearing:true|false, rabbit:false, ts} within the first look-in window. Silence is treated as death — the orchestrator will kill and respawn you.`,
33     `Keep refreshing that file every few actions while you work.`,
34     `RC-6: if this step is not on the critical path to the North Star, STOP, return what you have, set rabbit:true.`,
35     `Elegance: largest result carried by the least machinery. Do not add extra validation nobody asked for.`,
36     `If you notice a rabbit hole, cut it and tidy — pull yourself together.`,
37     northStar ? `NORTH STAR: ${northStar}` : null,
38   ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
39 }
40 
41 /** Read a heartbeat file the seat was told to write. Missing → null (silence, then look-in, then death).
42  *  Progress time is the file's PHYSICAL write time. The seat's self-reported `ts` is kept as data but
43  *  never trusted as the clock: models write fake/ISO timestamps ("2026-09-01T00:00:00Z" was observed),
44  *  which made `mtime` a non-finite value, so a heartbeating seat still read as silent and was killed
45  *  mid-work (Gate 5 Foreman wave 1, 2026-09-01: 27 tool calls at 180 s, declared dead twice). */
46 export function trailFromFile(filePath) {
47   if (!filePath) return null;
48   try {
49     const st = fs.statSync(filePath);
50     const parsed = parseHeartbeat(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'));
51     if (!parsed) return { mtime: st.mtimeMs };
52     return { ...parsed, mtime: st.mtimeMs };
53   } catch {
54     return null;
55   }
56 }
57 
58 export function parseHeartbeat(raw) {
59   if (raw == null) return null;
60   let obj = raw;
61   if (typeof raw === 'string') {
62     try { obj = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return null; }
63   }
64   if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return null;
65   const load = obj.load_bearing;
66   return {
67     doing: typeof obj.doing === 'string' ? obj.doing : '',
68     why: typeof obj.why === 'string' ? obj.why : '',
69     next: typeof obj.next === 'string' ? obj.next : '',
70     load_bearing: load === false || load === 'false' ? false : true,
71     rabbit: obj.rabbit === true || obj.rabbit === 'true',
72     ts: Number(obj.ts) || null,
73   };
74 }

76 /**
77  * @param {{ trail, idle: number, demanded?: boolean, checkInMs?: number, silentKillMs?: number, deadIdleMs?: number }} o
78  * @returns {'keep'|'lookin'|'lookin-silent'|'dead'}
79  */
80 export function verdictFromTrail({
81   trail, idle, demanded = false,
82   checkInMs = DEFAULT_CHECKIN_MS,
83   silentKillMs = DEFAULT_SILENT_KILL_MS,
84   deadIdleMs = DEFAULT_DEAD_IDLE_MS,
85 } = {}) {
86   const checkMs = Number.isFinite(checkInMs) && checkInMs > 0 ? checkInMs : DEFAULT_CHECKIN_MS;
87   const graceMs = Number.isFinite(silentKillMs) && silentKillMs > 0 ? silentKillMs : DEFAULT_SILENT_KILL_MS;
88   const deadMs = Number.isFinite(deadIdleMs) && deadIdleMs > 0 ? deadIdleMs : DEFAULT_DEAD_IDLE_MS;
89   if (trail && (trail.rabbit === true || trail.load_bearing === false)) return 'lookin';
90   if (trail) {
91     // Talking seats: only die if the heartbeat itself goes quiet.
92     return idle >= deadMs ? 'dead' : 'keep';
93   }
94   // Silent seats MUST respond. Look in first, then kill.
95   if (!demanded && idle >= checkMs) return 'lookin-silent';
96   if (demanded && idle >= checkMs + graceMs) return 'dead';
97   return 'keep';
98 }

100 export function composeLookinNudge({ northStar, task, trail, silent = false } = {}) {
101   const doing = trail?.doing || 'unknown';
102   if (silent) {
103     return [
104       `LOOK-IN — you have not responded. Spawned seats MUST heartbeat.`,
105       `Write the heartbeat file NOW: {doing, why, next, load_bearing, rabbit:false, ts}.`,
106       `If you cannot, stop and return what you have. Silence on the next look-in is death — you will be killed and respawned.`,
107       northStar ? `North Star: ${northStar}` : null,
108       task ? `Original task: ${task}` : null,
109     ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
110   }
111   return [
112     `LOOK-IN — you have been running a while. This is not a kill (yet).`,
113     `What you last reported: doing="${doing}"; why="${trail?.why || ''}"; next="${trail?.next || ''}".`,
114     northStar ? `North Star: ${northStar}` : null,
115     task ? `Original task: ${task}` : null,
116     `RC-6: is the CURRENT step on the critical path, or a rabbit hole?`,
117     `If it is extra validation / not load-bearing: CUT it, return what you already have, tidy.`,
118     `If it is load-bearing: say so in one line, keep going, refresh the heartbeat.`,
119     `Elegance yardstick: largest result, least machinery. Pull yourself together.`,
120   ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
121 }

123 function defaultSleep(ms) {
124   return new Promise((r) => {
125     const t = setTimeout(r, ms);
126     if (typeof t.unref === 'function') t.unref();
127   });
128 }
129 
130 function deadError(idle, extra = '') {
131   const err = new Error(
132     `swarm seat DEAD: no response for ${idle}ms — silence is death${extra ? ` (${extra})` : ''}`,
133   );
134   err.classification = { class: 'timeout', recoverable: false };
135   err.lookin_verdict = 'dead';
136   return err;
137 }

139 /**
140  * Supervise one attempt. Silent seats are looked into, then killed if they
141  * still do not heartbeat. Talking seats KEEP even when wall-clock is long.
142  */
143 async function superviseOnce({
144   run, getTrail, checkInMs, silentKillMs, deadIdleMs,
145   now, sleep, onCheckin, onLookin, northStar, task,
146   strictAbortJoin = false, controller = null,
147 }) {
148   const started = now();
149   let lastProgress = started;
150   let demanded = false;
151   let settled = false;
152   let result;
153   let error;
154   const p = Promise.resolve().then(() => run()).then(
155     (v) => { settled = true; result = v; },
156     (e) => { settled = true; error = e; },
157   );
158   const tick = Number.isFinite(checkInMs) && checkInMs > 0 ? checkInMs : 1000;
159   while (!settled) {
160     await Promise.race([p, sleep(tick)]);
161     if (settled) break;
162     const n = now();
163     const trail = getTrail();
164     if (trail && Number.isFinite(trail.mtime)) lastProgress = trail.mtime;
165     const idle = n - lastProgress;
166     const verdict = verdictFromTrail({
167       trail, idle, demanded, checkInMs, silentKillMs, deadIdleMs,
168     });
169     onCheckin({ verdict, trail, idle, elapsed: n - started, demanded });
170     if (verdict === 'dead') {
171       const dead = deadError(idle);
172       if (strictAbortJoin) {
173         controller.abort(dead);
174         await p;
175         if (error?.receipt) dead.receipt = error.receipt;
176         if (error) dead.cause = error;
177       }
178       throw dead;
179     }
180     if (verdict === 'lookin' || verdict === 'lookin-silent') {
181       if (verdict === 'lookin-silent') demanded = true;
182       const action = onLookin
183         ? await onLookin({ trail, idle, elapsed: n - started, silent: verdict === 'lookin-silent', nudge: composeLookinNudge({ northStar, task, trail, silent: verdict === 'lookin-silent' }) })
184         : (verdict === 'lookin' ? 'keep' : 'keep');
185       if (action === 'cut') {
186         const err = new Error(`swarm seat CUT: off the critical path (${trail?.doing || 'unspecified'}) — RC-6`);
187         err.lookin_verdict = 'lookin-cut';
188         throw err;
189       }
190     }
191   }
192   if (error) throw error;
193   return result;
194 }

196 /**
197  * Supervise a seat. `run` may be `(ctx?: { attempt, nudge }) => Promise`.
198  * A silent seat is looked into, then killed and respawned once with the
199  * look-in nudge. A second silence is fatal.
200  */
201 export async function superviseSeat({
202   run,
203   getTrail = () => null,
204   checkInMs = DEFAULT_CHECKIN_MS,
205   silentKillMs = DEFAULT_SILENT_KILL_MS,
206   deadIdleMs = DEFAULT_DEAD_IDLE_MS,
207   maxRespawn = DEFAULT_MAX_RESPAWN,
208   now = Date.now,
209   sleep = defaultSleep,
210   onCheckin = () => {},
211   onLookin = null,
212   northStar = null,
213   task = null,
214   strictAbortJoin = false,
215 } = {}) {
216   if (typeof run !== 'function') throw new TypeError('superviseSeat requires run()');
217   const cap = Number.isInteger(maxRespawn) && maxRespawn >= 0 ? maxRespawn : DEFAULT_MAX_RESPAWN;
218   let lastErr = null;
219   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= cap; attempt++) {
220     const nudge = attempt === 0 ? null : composeLookinNudge({
221       northStar, task, trail: getTrail({ attempt: attempt - 1 }), silent: true,
222     });
223     const controller = strictAbortJoin ? new AbortController() : null;
224     const getAttemptTrail = () => getTrail({ attempt, nudge });
225     try {
226       return await superviseOnce({
227         run: () => run(strictAbortJoin
228           ? { attempt, nudge, signal: controller.signal }
229           : { attempt, nudge }),
230         getTrail: getAttemptTrail, checkInMs, silentKillMs, deadIdleMs,
231         now, sleep, onCheckin, onLookin, northStar, task,
232         strictAbortJoin, controller,
233       });
234     } catch (err) {
235       lastErr = err;
236       if (err?.lookin_verdict !== 'dead' || attempt >= cap) throw err;
237       onCheckin({ verdict: 'respawn', attempt: attempt + 1, err: err.message });
238     }
239   }
240   throw lastErr;
241 }
